title: Movilización política
goal: Read three landmark moments of Indigenous political mobilization: Ecuador's CONAIE uprisings (1990, 2000), Mexico's January 1994 Zapatista rebellion, and Evo Morales becoming Bolivia's first Indigenous president in January 2006.

items: Describe what CONAIE organized in Ecuador in 1990.
Explain what happened in Chiapas on January 1, 1994.
State what CONAIE contributed to in 2000.
Use al grito de to introduce a mobilizing slogan.
I can describe what CONAIE organized in Ecuador in 1990.
